messages.author: fecbe3dc811bed89
messages.subject: Using romberg approximation in MakeADFun?
parts:
Dear TMB developers,

Thanks for this great TMB package. I learn that TMB uses Laplace approximation by default, but it may be not appropriate for categorical data (e.g.,

Accuracy of Laplace approximation for discrete response mixed models; http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0167947308002533). Can I use other approximation such as romberg in MakeADFun?


Best,

CW

messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: Using romberg approximation in MakeADFun?
parts:
Alternatives to the Laplace approximation are not yet available via MakeADFun.

You can use other methods but it will require more work.
Fore example, here is how to use adaptive Gauss-Kronrod quadrature from within the template:

https://github.com/kaskr/adcomp/blob/master/tmb_examples/adaptive_integration.cpp

A (partial) example of Romberg integration is also available:

http://kaskr.github.io/adcomp/namespaceromberg.html

Something like this would apply for categorical data as well. It might be useful to add a Romberg-version of 'tmb_examples/socatt.cpp' ?
